summary: Barnwell County, SC lookout registered in 2026; one lookout list marks it removed, the register does not say, and no build date was found.

facts.status_note: One lookout list marks Elko as removed; no dated source confirms whether anything still stands.

evidence.supports: Listed under the South Carolina Forestry Commission
The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993.

notes_for_editor: Status is the main open question. NHLR registered Elko in 2026 with a photo and no description of present condition. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts list marks it Removed with no date. No build date was found. The SCFC closure date applies to the whole tower system, not to Elko specifically. This is not the Barnwell lookout (us-sc-barnwell), which is a different tower. The standing-to-removed correction is dropped: the register does not say whether anything stands, so the status stays open.
